description.value: The Annex is a family-friendly lodge cafeteria at Sun Peaks Resort, perched at the base of the Sunburst Express chairlift next to Parking Lot 2. It serves hearty, casual fare with fast service and is famous for its fresh-baked cinnamon buns made every morning. Cyclists heading into or out of the resort's bike park and trail network will find it a convenient stop, with daily cubby storage available for belongings on a first-come, first-served basis.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Annex is a family-friendly lodge cafeteria at the base of the Sunburst Express chairlift at Sun Peaks Resort, operating April 7 to mid-November (summer season), making it open as of the current date (May 28, 2026). Free Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed by the website; vegetarian and vegan diet options are supported by OSM tags (diet:vegan=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes) but not explicitly detailed on the website page fetched.
